events.info: Francesca Fiorentini is a journalist, podcaster, and stand up comedian. She has been featured on the podcast Lovett or Leave It, the BBC Arts Hour, and has been part of SF Sketchfest, SF Comedy Day, and the Asian-American Comedy Festival in LA. She hosts her very successful weekly political comedy podcast The Bitchuation Room, performs regularly at the Improv and the Ice House, where she hosts her sold out monthly show, New World Disorder, and tours comedy clubs across the country co-headlining with her husband, Matt Lieb.
events.pleaseNote: Francesca Fiorentini is a journalist, podcaster, and stand up comedian. Join us in our Callback Bar 1 hour before door time! This show is 21 & over with valid, government-issued photo ID. 18+ with parent or legal guardian over 30. There is a two-beverage minimum per person inside of the showroom. Cameras and video/audio recording devices are not permitted. Our events often run for multiple dates/times. Before purchasing, please ensure that you can attend the specific event, date, and time that is listed on the event page. There are no refunds/exchanges unless an event is cancelled/postponed. $.25 per each ticket sold for a majority of events at Punch Line benefits Comedy Gives Back, a safety net for the comedy community. For more information, please visit www.comedygivesback.com.
